Add and Remove Knots

Note on the vignettes

This is the only vignette of the package BsplineQuantRegGui. Since Shiny applications are best documented with pictures, and to limit the size of the package, we present all the interactive features in this single vignette. All functionalities are also described in the README.

Introduction

In this vignette, we show how to add and remove knots to define the spline.

Two sets of knots exist together: - The set of regularly spaced knots auto knots, - The set of manual knots. These two sets are joined dynamically to form the full set of knots used by the regression.

The number of auto knots can be changed at any time, this setting applies only once the “auto knot” button is pressed, when the data are defined or loaded.

It is possible to remove knots from both auto and manual sets.

Manual knots are added when entering the mode “add knots”. Rules: - it is not possible to add an already existing knot - One can remove all manual knots at once - There is no difference in the regression between an “auto not” and a “manual knot”

Load the data

Click on the Test button to load the demo data with a default set of knots.

Convexity constraint (Conv = U)

Select a knot

To select a knot, simply click on it in the plot. The selected knot is highlighted and its index and value appear in the information bar.

Initial set of knots

Remove knots

Click on the Remove selected knot button several times to remove the selected knot and the next ones. After each removal, the next knot is automatically selected.

One knot is selected

Add knots

Click on the Add knot button to enter the manual addition mode. The button label changes to Stop while the mode is active.

knots are removed

Reduce the number of auto knot

If needed, reduce the number of auto knots (for example to 4). The change takes effect after pressing Set auto knots.

‘Add Knot’ is selected

Run when ready

Once the knots are set, click on Run to fit the spline.

add manual knots

run again with some more knots

You can add more knots and run again to see the effect on the fitted curve.

regression curve with manual knots

Regression curve with more knots

Then remove the manual knots (red upper button)

To remove all manual knots at once, click on the red Clear manual knots button. Auto knots are preserved.

Remove the manual knots
